import subprocess, json, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace")
from runtime_limits import limit_child
def run(data):
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/gateway.py'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=limit_child,
        env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/workspace','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C','TMPDIR':'/workspace/tmp'})
    o,e = p.communicate(data)
    return p.returncode, o[:400], e[:400]
for label, data in [
    ("empty", b""),
    ("not json", b"hello"),
    ("empty obj", b"{}"),
    ("null", b"null"),
    ("list", b"[]"),
    ("jobs not list", b'{"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":{}}'),
    ("job missing raw", b'{"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":[{"gateway":"g","ingress":{"kind":"untrusted"},"trusted_out":true}]}'),

]:
